data.name: Multiple-seed reproducibility
data.research_question: Do the observed experimental improvements remain consistent across different random seeds?
data.hypothesis: The E2-D ranking advantage will persist across seeds, but absolute metrics will vary.
data.training_strategy: Repeat the selected configurations with seeds 42, 123 and 456; report mean, standard deviation and individual outcomes.
data.checkpoint_selection: Same benign-validation checkpoint rule as the original experiment.
data.interpretation: Current results are single-seed and should not be treated as stable estimates.

warnings: Static aggregate snapshot. Event-level provenance is intentionally excluded.
